# pangolin_resource_policies (Data Source)

Lists the shared resource policies (Enterprise) of the organization, with the resources attached to each one. The per-resource inline policies are not listed. Use `pangolin_resource_policy` for the full settings of one policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Shared resource policies of the org, filtered on name / nice ID.
data "pangolin_resource_policies" "internal" {
  query = "internal"
}

# Map each policy name to the resources attached to it.
output "policy_resources" {
  value = {
    for p in data.pangolin_resource_policies.internal.policies :
    p.name => [for r in p.resources : r.name]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `query` (String) Only return policies whose name or nice ID contains this text (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) List of resource policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The resource policy ID.
- `name` (String) Display name of the policy.
- `nice_id` (String) Readable ID, unique per org.
- `resources` (Attributes List) Resources attached to the policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--policies--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies.resources`

Read-Only:

- `full_domain` (String) The resource full domain, or `null` for non-HTTP resources.
- `name` (String) The resource name.
- `nice_id` (String) The resource nice ID.
- `resource_id` (Number) The resource ID.
